title: I'm Now in the Lovense App! (ORIGINAL)
description: In partnership with Lovense I am now the flagship creator for their new Audio Stories page! By simply opening the Lovense App you now get access to a sample of some of my favorite interactive haptic files to enjoy easily at your fingertips. As of now there are 6 audios on offer, but we'll be regularly adding to that collection to keep things fresh and interesting. This also comes with the added benefit of native iOS support of course and we'll be enabling a Lovense button on haptic-supported pages on Shibbydex in the coming days to enable iOS support site-wide. To check out whats on offer, all you need to do is: - Open the Lovense App - Make sure your device is switched on and paired - Click the "Toy" tab - Click "Audio Stories" - Done! Hopefully this is a great new feature for existing fans who just want a quick and easy way to experience haptics on demand as well as introducing a whole new set of people down the spiralling weird and wonderful rabbit hole of hypnosis and my content. Even though this is a brilliant new partnership I am extremely proud and excited about, the audios on the App itself have needed to be censored somewhat, so if you want to experience my full collection of files and haptics then the Shibbydex is still going to be the best place to go. Enjoy!
author: Mistress Shibby
